title: Twig 3.31.0 released
content:
<html><head></head><body>Twig 3.31.0 is out. It adds a collate() function to sort strings in the
alphabetical order of a language, lets you mark a Markup value as safe for
some escaping strategies only, makes attribute-based extensions easier to
write and to load lazily, and makes…</body></html>
author: Fabien Potencier
